# Constitutional Carry

Commonly referred to as; “permitless carry” or “constitutional carry,”  Senate Bill 215 legislation has made several changes to Ohio’s concealed carry laws. For more information see the [Constitutional Carry Act Summary](https://www.legislature.ohio.gov/download?key=18493&format=pdf) from the Ohio Legislative Service Commission .

Senate Bill 215 has been [signed into law](https://www.buckeyefirearms.org/ohio-governor-dewine-signs-bfa-supported-permitless-carry-bill) and will make it legal to carry a concealed handgun without a license in Ohio beginning on **June 13, 2022.**

###### Additional Resources:

- [Constitutional Carry FAQ](https://www.hcso.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/Constitutional-Carry-3.pdf)
- [SB 215 Information Video](https://onedrive.live.com/?authkey=%21AHw7OjVLKSpMTI8&cid=DC7FC9E19B4FE6E5&id=DC7FC9E19B4FE6E5%2173651&parId=DC7FC9E19B4FE6E5%2173568&o=OneUp)
